subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` enforcement for existing groups with configured bot identity but no text mention regexes?
rationale: The code path is localized and well-covered, but the PR intentionally changes upgrade behavior for existing Signal group configurations, so automation should not decide the compatibility policy tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context when bot identity is configured.

options.title: Require A Transition Path
options.body: Ask for an explicit migration, opt-in strict mode, or release-note compatibility plan if existing pass-through behavior must be preserved for some deployments.

options.title: Pause Native Identity Enforcement
options.body: Pause or close this stack if configured Signal identity should not make native mention detection enforceable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context when bot identity is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy work plus top-level project ownership make this the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
